items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: What did you learn from her? ... Her and Wynton Marsalis actually taught me how to really study music.

ctx.x: I mean if they’re just not professional, you know? Like if anyone is just unprofessional or you know just not a nice person. I mean you’d be surprised — you can be the most talented person in the world but if no one likes you they won’t call you. You know. Like if you’re not easy to work with or there’s always a thing then it’s not going to work out. And you can be like the fifth most talented person in the room or so, and if you’re easy to work — and you come correct, and you come with all your music ready and…
Geri Allen was important in your career?
